review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–152) from the supplied text. I did not open any related sources. The file defines no functions, structures or maps. It contains only theorems that compute invariants of a fifth cyclotomic field K: finrank, discr, real and complex place counts, the intrinsic label, monogenicity, class number, unit rank, torsion order, and the ramification data of 5. Each is a one-line value or property statement, proved mostly by delegating to Mathlib's `IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.*` lemmas. There is no function with separate preservation, inverse or compatibility lemmas that could become a LinearMap, RingHom, equivalence or bundled action. The only parameter-dependent declarations take a prime ideal 𝔭 over 5 and state equalities about it, so they have no bundled-structure form either. The rubric has no suitable target here. I report no finding.
